answer: At epoch open each node commits a unique Blake3 state root over a dedicated 8 GB RAM array filled with a per-identity pearl seed, then proves possession with 256 random offset queries in 30 seconds. The verifier re-checks the echo root against the committed hash; any node that cannot answer from the same array has its grades discarded, its bond slashed 30 percent, and its identity frozen six epochs. One honest agent holds one 8 GB array; ten fakes must hold 80 GB of distinct arrays and answer 2560 queries, a sable cost above honest participation.
